2014_spells.mind-spike.description: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you always know the target's location until the spell ends, but only if the target is within 60 feet of you.
2014_spells.mind-spike.effectSummary: Deal 3d8 psychic damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.mind-spike.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you reach into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; On a failed save, you always know the target's location until the spell ends, but only if the target is within 60 feet of you; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd. On a failed save, you always know the target's location until the spell ends, but only if the target is within 60 feet of you; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
